mapper.select: SELECT id FROM spots WHERE legacy_place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM poi_categories WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS placeGroupId, name AS placeGroupName, short_name AS placeGroupShortName, COALESCE(route_graph_status, 'none') AS routeGraphStatus, city, address, longitude, latitude FROM place_groups WHERE id = #{placeGroupId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.spot_id AS spotId, p.place_group_id AS placeGroupId, p.name, c.code AS categoryCode, c.name AS categoryName, p.area_code AS areaCode, p.area_name AS areaName, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.map_x AS mapX, p.map_y AS mapY FROM pois p JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND p.status = 1 AND COALESCE(p.area_code, '') != 'campus_summary' AND p.map_x IS NOT NULL AND p.map_y IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.area_code = 'route' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, p.id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.spot_id AS spotId, p.place_group_id AS placeGroupId, p.name, c.code AS categoryCode, c.name AS categoryName, p.area_code AS areaCode, p.area_name AS areaName, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.map_x AS mapX, p.map_y AS mapY FROM pois p JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND p.id = #{poiId} AND p.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id, e.from_poi_id AS fromPoiId, e.to_poi_id AS toPoiId, e.distance_m AS distanceM, e.duration_min AS durationMin, e.transport_type AS transportType, e.is_indoor AS indoor, e.description FROM route_edges e JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND fp.status = 1 AND tp.status = 1 ORDER BY e.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pois (spot_id, poi_role, place_group_id, category_id, name, scene, area_code, area_name, province, city, address, location_text, description, longitude, latitude, map_x, map_y, rating, hotness, visit_count, status) SELECT #{spotId}, 'route_legacy', #{placeGroupId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, 'campus', 'route', '路线节点', '北京市', pg.city, pg.address, pg.short_name, #{name}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{mapX}, #{mapY}, 4.8, 0, 0, 1 FROM place_groups pg WHERE pg.id = #{placeGroupId}

INSERT INTO pois (spot_id, poi_role, place_group_id, category_id, name, scene, area_code, area_name, province, city, address, location_text, description, longitude, latitude, map_x, map_y, rating, hotness, visit_count, status) SELECT #{spotId}, 'internal', #{placeGroupId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, 'campus', #{areaCode}, #{areaName}, '北京市', pg.city, CONCAT(pg.address, ' ', #{name}), pg.short_name, CONCAT('后台路网标注页补充 POI：', #{name}), #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{mapX}, #{mapY}, 4.8, 1000, 1000, 1 FROM place_groups pg WHERE pg.id = #{placeGroupId}
mapper.delete: DELETE e FROM route_edges e JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND (e.from_poi_id = #{poiId} OR e.to_poi_id = #{poiId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO route_edges (from_poi_id, to_poi_id, distance_m, duration_min, transport_type, congestion_factor, is_indoor, description) VALUES (#{fromPoiId}, #{toPoiId}, #{distanceM}, #{durationMin}, #{transportType}, #{congestionFactor}, #{indoor}, #{description})

INSERT INTO route_graph_versions (place_group_id, version_no, name, snapshot_json, node_count, edge_count, created_by, remark) VALUES (#{placeGroupId}, #{versionNo}, #{name}, #{snapshotJson}, #{nodeCount}, #{edgeCount}, #{createdBy}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.place_group_id AS placeGroupId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.name, v.node_count AS nodeCount, v.edge_count AS edgeCount, v.created_by AS createdBy, u.username AS createdByName, v.remark, v.created_at AS createdAt FROM route_graph_versions v LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = v.created_by WHERE v.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC, v.id DESC

SELECT v.id, v.place_group_id AS placeGroupId, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.name, v.snapshot_json AS snapshotJson, v.node_count AS nodeCount, v.edge_count AS edgeCount, v.created_by AS createdBy, u.username AS createdByName, v.remark, v.created_at AS createdAt FROM route_graph_versions v LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = v.created_by WHERE v.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND v.id = #{versionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pois p WHERE ) AS poiCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pois p WHERE p.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.area_code = 'route' ) AS routeNodeCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM route_edges e JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND fp.status = 1 AND tp.status = 1 ) AS edgeCount
SELECT p.id AS nodeId, p.name AS nodeName FROM pois p WHERE AND (p.map_x IS NULL OR p.map_y IS NULL) ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT p.id AS nodeId, p.name AS nodeName FROM pois p WHERE AND p.map_x IS NOT NULL AND p.map_y IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM route_edges e WHERE e.from_poi_id = p.id OR e.to_poi_id = p.id ) ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT p.id AS nodeId, p.name AS nodeName FROM pois p WHERE p.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.area_code = 'route' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM route_edges e WHERE e.from_poi_id = p.id OR e.to_poi_id = p.id ) ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT e.id AS edgeId, e.from_poi_id AS fromNodeId, fp.name AS fromNodeName, e.to_poi_id AS toNodeId, tp.name AS toNodeName, e.distance_m AS distanceM FROM route_edges e JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND fp.status = 1 AND tp.status = 1 AND e.distance_m > #{maxDistanceM} AND e.from_poi_id < e.to_poi_id ORDER BY e.distance_m DESC, e.id ASC

SELECT MIN(e.id) AS edgeId, e.from_poi_id AS fromNodeId, fp.name AS fromNodeName, e.to_poi_id AS toNodeId, tp.name AS toNodeName, COUNT(*) AS duplicateCount FROM route_edges e JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} GROUP BY e.from_poi_id, fp.name, e.to_poi_id, tp.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY duplicateCount DESC, edgeId ASC

SELECT e.id AS edgeId, e.from_poi_id AS fromNodeId, fp.name AS fromNodeName, e.to_poi_id AS toNodeId, tp.name AS toNodeName, e.distance_m AS distanceM FROM route_edges e JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND e.from_poi_id = e.to_poi_id ORDER BY e.id ASC

SELECT e.id AS edgeId, e.from_poi_id AS fromNodeId, fp.name AS fromNodeName, e.to_poi_id AS toNodeId, tp.name AS toNodeName, e.distance_m AS distanceM FROM route_edges e LEFT JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id LEFT JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE (fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} OR tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId}) AND ( fp.id IS NULL OR tp.id IS NULL OR fp.status != 1 OR tp.status != 1 ) ORDER BY e.id ASC

SELECT e.id AS edgeId, e.from_poi_id AS fromNodeId, fp.name AS fromNodeName, e.to_poi_id AS toNodeId, tp.name AS toNodeName, e.distance_m AS distanceM FROM route_edges e JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE (fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} OR tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId}) AND fp.place_group_id != tp.place_group_id ORDER BY e.id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE e FROM route_edges e LEFT JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id LEFT JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE (fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} OR tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId}) AND ( fp.id IS NULL OR tp.id IS NULL OR fp.status != 1 OR tp.status != 1 )

DELETE e FROM route_edges e JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE (fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} OR tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId}) AND fp.place_group_id != tp.place_group_id

DELETE e FROM route_edges e JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND e.from_poi_id = e.to_poi_id

DELETE e FROM route_edges e JOIN ( SELECT duplicate_edge_ids.id FROM ( SELECT e1.id FROM route_edges e1 JOIN pois fp1 ON fp1.id = e1.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp1 ON tp1.id = e1.to_poi_id JOIN ( SELECT e2.from_poi_id, e2.to_poi_id, MIN(e2.id) AS keep_id FROM route_edges e2 JOIN pois fp2 ON fp2.id = e2.from_poi_id JOIN pois tp2 ON tp2.id = e2.to_poi_id WHERE fp2.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp2.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} GROUP BY e2.from_poi_id, e2.to_poi_id ) kept ON kept.from_poi_id = e1.from_poi_id AND kept.to_poi_id = e1.to_poi_id WHERE fp1.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp1.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND e1.id != kept.keep_id ) duplicate_edge_ids ) duplicated ON duplicated.id = e.id
